question:
Find out the correct alternative that when filled in the blanks in the same sequence will make the series logically complete.

K_Y _KUT R_PO MKK_ HK_EB
solution:
Given : K_Y _KUT R_PO MKK_ HK_EB

By checking options :

 
• WKBFP → K__W__Y __K__KUT R__B__PO MKK__F__ HK__P__EB → (It doesn't Follows the pattern)
 
• WBHZP → K__W__Y __B__KUT R__H__PO MKK__Z__ HK__P__EB → (It doesn't Follows the pattern)
 
• ZWKJF → K__Z__Y __W__KUT R__K__PO MKK__J__ HK__F__EB → (It follows the pattern of : [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8c75c9f30180a2f7a6f70ba4a84de09e9abaf6d664d62ddd678d9ef5528de25d.png] 
 
• ZKWLF → K__Z__Y __K__KUT R__W__PO MKK__L__ HK__F__EB → (It doesn't Follows the pattern)

Hence, "ZWKJF" is the correct answer.
